checks.description: When the last key releases during glide, pitch continues toward C5 while amp enters Release.

behavior: At 0.5 s, a 100 ms glide begins from A4 to C5. The overlapping press sends no trigger.
Releasing the lower-priority A4 at 0.52 s does not change the target pitch.
The last key releases at 0.55 s, setting key.gate to 0. Glide continues to C5 at 0.6 s without creating a new target.
Amp releases from its current value at 0.55 s and finishes at 0.85 s; the same voice is used throughout.
